reason: At handleCancelBooking.ts:458-470 the recurring-series branch runs `.forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(credential); ... apiDeletes.push(await calendar?.deleteEvent(...)) })`. Nothing awaits these callbacks, so `await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes))` at line 652 can run before anything is pushed, and errors become unhandled rejections. The forEach(async)/push-after-await pattern was already there before this patch; the patch's added `await getCalendar` at line 461 only delays the deletes further.
